items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: He was a ladies' man, and he used to go to Healy's, and maybe he helped us, I don't know.

ctx.x: Well, I'm not familiar with it.

They had four places in that one building. Ours was the ballroom. We had Healy's Restaurant on the bottom floor. About that time, the Duke of Wales was cutting quite a sloth in New York. He was a ladies' man, and he used to go to Healy's, and maybe he helped us, I don't know. But it was a very popular spot, 66th and Columbus.

Talking about style, on your other interview you mentioned arguing with the Captain Strykfuss about the kind of music you'd play on the boat. He said something about he wanted you to play like what he'd heard in St. Louis, and he says you're in New Orleans and you play like what people in New Orleans wanted. How would you contrast the two?
